$comment: Layer D for LEDGERX: static data-flow equivalence for the program outputs (COUNT, TOTAL, FEE, FIRST, LAST, TIER). The INDEXED file's key ordering is a dynamic property of the record set, so FIRST/LAST are covered by layers A/B on every case (candidate B's seed-order iteration is layer B's catch); layer D checks each key is derived from the record fields on both sides rather than fabricated.
